title: skills(objectstack-automation): a flow's record nodes treat a computed filter operand as a value, never as a query operator (#29404) — the automation skill and flows page should say so
body:
domain:server#5 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQKwKFCp1m6Pb6Q8c1

Source: the `Skills-docs:` line of PR #29404 (card #29050, handled under ruling C). `skills/**` is Tier H, so the edit is its own card. State the rule only, in the same words the changeset uses. No examples of refused values and no "before" behaviour.

**The rule (from the changeset).** A flow's record nodes (`get_record`, `update_record`, `delete_record`) treat an evaluated value in a filter's operand position as a value, never as a query operator. A value is a string, number, boolean or date. At the comparand of `$in`, `$nin` or `$between` it may be a list of them. Anything else fails the node as a guard before the query runs. The filter the author wrote and every literal operand are unchanged.

**Files.**
- `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md`: where record-node filters are described, add the rule and the author's fix: make the expression evaluate to the compared value (for a record, its `id`), and write conditions in the filter itself.
- `content/docs/automation/flows.mdx`: the same sentence in the record-node section.

Lands after #29404 merges. Text only.
